Market today: The market mood is mixed. Morgan Stanley is bullish, but geopolitical tensions around AI chip sales to China and global economic warnings from the IMF could create headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip portfolio.

Your holdings: Several leveraged ETFs are deep in the red and need immediate attention, especially SOXL (-74.05%) and MUU (-53.8%). SMCI (-38.78%) is also a significant concern. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any developments regarding AI chip export controls to China. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs, as decay adds to their downside risk.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater leveraged positions, especially given your margin exposure.
plays: Trim SOXL and MUU: These leveraged chip ETFs are down significantly (-74.05%, -53.8%) and decay over time. Consider reducing exposure to manage margin risk.
Respect SMCI stop: SMCI is down -38.78%. Watch its stop at 37.3 closely; a break could signal further downside.
Consider CRWD profit-taking: CRWD is up 29.54%. Trimming some gains here could reduce overall portfolio risk and free up capital.
